newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NOL to build container port in Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: NOL to build container port in Vietnam.

text.p: Neptune Orient Lines Ltd (NOL) will develop and operate a container terminal in the Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, said Lua Cheng Eng, the company's chief executive officer on Monday.

Lua said the terminal project will be undertaken in three phases with the first phase estimated to cost U.S.$50 million. He said the construction of the container terminal has commenced and will be completed in January 1998.
NOL is developing the terminal through a joint venture company with Mitsui and Company. The joint-venture is Mitorient Enterprise Private Limited.
NOL's effective share in the joint-venture is 41.25 percent.
